title: A genuine Mira face rejection must enable a new same-winner candidate to be independently verified, not permanently pin rejected original media
root_cause: The compile-time frozen external source winner bound its immutable editorial source and scene to a single OpenArt history/MP4. Independent 0.920 face rejection was correctly fail-closed, but different original-master retakes could not enter final-media verification at all, leaving an unrepairable daily Instagram obligation.
impact: Even a valid same-source new candidate was hard rejected before three-frame and temporal verification. Canonical Instagram remains BLOCKED with no actual Meta provider ID.
fix: Admit only same-source, same-project, official-master, distinct image2video replacements following an actual identity rejection. Promote only the existing router's independently verified exact-media SHA, three face frames >=0.940 and temporal proof, with unchanged frozen source/caption, original publisher and one-time provider capability.
prevention_rule: A frozen editorial winner freezes topic/source/caption, never permanently freezes an independently rejected video. Do not classify a candidate as approved before real exact-media vision and temporal verification; never replay a known provider post; do not create duplicate schedulers or writers.
release_gates: Required CI and CodeQL exact head
Native Supabase Preview where required and protected merge
Existing canonical media verifier actual independent start/middle/end >=0.940 and temporal proof
Authorized one-time Instagram publish and external Meta ID/permalink/readback
outcome: Source PR only. Does not claim a new video passed or that Instagram was published.
